name: Fabrica AI Grouting Robot V5
summary: Small 70 kg robot that maps a tiled room by itself, fills the tile joints with grout and washes off the excess, about 30 m² per hour.

germany.statusNote: Available on request in the EU but not yet sold there. Fabrica (Singapore) keeps a demo unit and an address in Brno, Czechia, and offers EU customers a free trial on a small area before commercial terms are agreed. Sales so far only in Singapore and Australia, pilots in the US; no EU customer, price or CE marking published. Shown at bauma 2025 in Munich.

sellers.name: Fabrica Robotics Pte. Ltd.
sellers.note: Demo request form on the home page. Demo unit and address in Brno, Czechia (Bašty 8, 602 00 Brno). Free trial first, commercial terms after; in Singapore it sells or rents robots with site support and maintenance.

specs.label: Footprint
specs.conditions: less than 70 cm on each side

specs.label: Grouting rate
specs.conditions: per robot; the same page also says 'up to 100 m²' per hour without conditions

specs.label: Unsupervised run
specs.conditions: 2+ hours before reloading grout and water, enough for a standard living room

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: computer vision; a camera checks for uncleaned grout and tile defects

notes: Maps rooms in real time; no floor plan or BIM data needed; started with one button.
Staff load grout and water and carry the robot between rooms separated by steps.
Drives around pipes and drain holes; red tape marks keep-out lines that are not walls.
Wheels seen on the maker's photo.

images.alt: Fabrica AI tile grouting robot with its orange sponge cleaning belt, standing on a tiled floor in an apartment

evidence.task: Grouting tiles on client projects; about 180,000 sq ft grouted by the end of 2025
evidence.where: Singapore (clients include Woh Hup and BHCC) and Australia
Gin Chia, Soilbuild, Chan Ren Fong and Dragages
evidence.note: Maker also reports pilots in the US (not named).
